title: Teacher Ambassador Registration
label: Teacher Ambassadors
intro: BE THE VOICE OF TEACHERS. BE PART OF THE CHANGE.
Teachers are among the most important voices in a child’s educational journey.
The School Expert™ is building a community that brings together teachers, parents, schools, education experts and organisations to create a stronger ecosystem around every child.
As a Teacher Ambassador, you can help us connect educators, share experiences, amplify teacher voices and create meaningful conversations around education.
We are looking for passionate educators who would like to contribute their time, experience, ideas and voice to the community.
Please complete this form to express your interest in becoming a The School Expert™ Teacher Ambassador.
outro: Thank you for expressing your interest in becoming a Teacher Ambassador for The School Expert™.
We believe teachers should not just participate in conversations about education — teachers should help lead them.
Our team will review your registration and get in touch with you regarding the next steps.
Made in India. For India. By Indians.
It takes a village to raise a child.
It takes an entire country to raise The School Expert™ for our children.

fields.label: As a Teacher Ambassador, which activities would you be interested in?
options: CONNECT – Introduce other teachers to The School Expert Community
CONTRIBUTE – Share articles, teaching ideas, resources and experiences
CONVERSE – Participate in discussions, webinars and panel conversations
COLLABORATE – Work with schools, educators and education organisations
MENTOR – Support fellow teachers and educators
CREATE – Help create educational content for parents, teachers and students
SPEAK – Participate as a speaker or subject expert
RESEARCH – Participate in education surveys and research initiatives
ADVOCATE – Represent and amplify the voice of teachers
LEAD – Help build the Teacher Ambassador network in my city / region
